item.title: Geologists may have solved mystery of Green River's 'uphill' route
item.description:
📝 In order to cut its surprising path through the Uinta Mountains, the Green River ran over land that was temporarily lowered when a lithospheric drip developed beneath the mountains several million years ago. It created the line that separates the rivers that flow into the Pacific from those that flow into the Atlantic, and created new habitat boundaries for wildlife that influenced their evolution. Their estimates match well with previous research that estimated the likely period of time during which the Green River cut through the mountains and integrated with the Colorado system.
🔗 Read more: https://phys.org/news/2026-01-geologists-mystery-green-river-uphill.html
